sentences.en: We like stories about leaders who have big ideas,
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢讲述那些拥有宏大构想的领导者的故事，

sentences.en: who defy the odds and pursue their goals with messianic purpose.
sentences.zh: 他们不畏艰难，怀揣着救世主般的使命感去追求目标。

sentences.en: Think of Winston Churchill in World War II,
sentences.zh: 想想二战时期的温斯顿·丘吉尔，

sentences.en: or Abraham Lincoln during the Civil War.
sentences.zh: 或是内战时期的亚伯拉罕·林肯。

sentences.en: But what happens when a leader's vision is the wrong one?
sentences.zh: 但如果领导者的愿景是错误的，会发生什么呢？

sentences.en: How do we think about people who dream big,
sentences.zh: 我们该如何看待那些怀揣宏大梦想，

sentences.en: At such times, we might prefer a more cautious style,
sentences.zh: 在那种时候，我们或许更倾向于一种谨慎的风格，
倾向于那些稳扎稳打的人。

sentences.en: Those leaders might not score historic triumphs,
sentences.zh: 这些领导者或许无法取得历史性的丰功伟绩，
但他们也很少引发灾难。

sentences.en: Thousands of years ago, the Greek poet Archilochus summed up this idea.
sentences.zh: 几千年前，希腊诗人阿基洛库斯总结了这个观点。

sentences.en: the fox knows many things, but the hedgehog knows one big thing.
sentences.zh: 狐狸知道许多事情，而刺猬只知道一件大事。

sentences.en: That parable has been the subject of much debate over the last 2,500 years,
sentences.zh: 这则寓言在过去2500年里一直是争论的焦点，
关于阿基洛库斯究竟意指什么。
这位是心理学家菲尔·泰特洛克。

sentences.en: Various people have offered various interpretations.
sentences.zh: 不同的人给出了不同的解读。

sentences.en: Some people coming out on the side of the hedgehog saying the hedgehog will trump the fox,
sentences.zh: 有些人站在刺猬这一边，认为刺猬会胜过狐狸，

sentences.en: and other people saying no, it really means the fox is going to do better.
sentences.zh: 而另一些人则说不，这其实意味着狐狸会做得更好。

sentences.en: There are different ways to think about the metaphor, but here's how I see it.
sentences.zh: 对于这个隐喻有不同的思考方式，但我是这样看的。

sentences.en: If a fox wants dinner, it has many options.
sentences.zh: 如果狐狸想吃晚餐，它有很多选择。

sentences.en: It can chase down a hedgehog.
sentences.zh: 它可以去追捕一只刺猬。

sentences.en: It can find something else to eat.
It can even go without food for a day.
sentences.zh: 它甚至可以一天不吃东西。

sentences.en: But if you're a hedgehog being chased by a fox,
sentences.zh: 但如果你是一只被狐狸追赶的刺猬，

sentences.en: Bill Tetlock thinks this metaphor also describes two different cognitive styles among people.
sentences.zh: 比尔·泰特洛克认为这个隐喻也描述了人们的两种不同认知风格。

sentences.en: Foxes have different strategies for different probleMs.
sentences.zh: 狐狸针对不同的问题有不同的策略。
它们乐于处理细微差别。

sentences.en: Hedgehogs focus on the big picture.
They see every problem through the lens of a single organizing principle.
sentences.zh: 它们通过单一的组织原则来看待每一个问题。

sentences.en: The hedgehogs are more parsimonious, more decisive.
In most MBA programs, they'd probably be viewed as better leadership material.
sentences.zh: 在大多数MBA课程中，他们可能会被视为更好的领导人才。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we're listening back to our May 2017 show
sentences.zh: 本周在《隐藏的大脑》中，我们将重温2017年5月的节目，

sentences.en: that tells the story of a hedgehog,
sentences.zh: 讲述了一只“刺猬”的故事，

sentences.en: a surgeon who changed the world in daring ways.
sentences.zh: 一位以大胆方式改变了世界的外科医生。

sentences.en: His bold style made him a pioneer in what has today become the transgender movement.
sentences.zh: 他大胆的风格使他成为当今跨性别运动的先驱之一。

sentences.en: It also propelled him to create one of the world's first international medical missions.
sentences.zh: 这也促使他创建了世界上首批国际医疗援助团之一。

sentences.en: Like other hedgehogs, this surgeon experienced outside success
sentences.zh: 像其他刺猬一样，这位外科医生经历了巨大的成功，
直到有一天，他不再成功。
那简直是一场该死的灾难。

sentences.en: Sandy Stone was born in 1936, in the midst of the Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 桑迪·斯通出生于1936年，正值大萧条时期。

sentences.en: Her parents gave her a Hebrew name.
sentences.zh: 她的父母给了她一个希伯来名字。
泽利格·本-纳坦，一个男孩的名字。

sentences.en: That's because her parents thought she was a boy.
sentences.zh: 那是因为她的父母以为她是男孩。

sentences.en: But from a very early age, she knew she was a girl.
sentences.zh: 但从很小的时候起，她就知道自己是个女孩。

sentences.en: This was a long time ago, decades before the modern trans movement.
sentences.zh: 那是在很久以前，在现代跨性别运动出现几十年前。

sentences.en: When Sandy was a child, there were no words, no language to describe what she knew about herself.
sentences.zh: 当桑迪还是个孩子时，没有任何词汇或语言来描述她对自己的认知。

sentences.en: It was all of those things.
sentences.zh: 那是所有这些感受的总和。

sentences.en: It stayed like that for Sandy all the way into adulthood.
sentences.zh: 这种情况一直伴随着桑迪，直到她成年。

sentences.en: She went to school, became a recording engineer, moved to the Bay Area.
sentences.zh: 她上了学，成为了一名录音工程师，搬到了湾区。

sentences.en: All the while, everyone thought she was a man.
sentences.zh: 一直以来，每个人都以为她是男人。

sentences.en: In the San Francisco phone book, she found a promising lead.
sentences.zh: 在旧金山的电话簿里，她发现了一个有希望的线索。

sentences.en: It was a group for gay men.
sentences.zh: 那是一个男同性恋团体。

sentences.en: When she called, they asked if she was gay.
sentences.zh: 当她打电话时，他们问她是不是同性恋。

sentences.en: So they sent her away and told her to try another group.
sentences.zh: 于是他们打发她走，让她去试试别的团体。

sentences.en: The outfit they recommended surprised Sandy.
sentences.zh: 他们推荐的那个机构让桑迪感到惊讶。

sentences.en: It was the San Francisco Police Department.
It turned out that the police department was running a counseling unit of sorts,
sentences.zh: 原来警察局当时在运营某种咨询部门，

sentences.en: which they did for the population of transgender people that lived in the San Francisco Tenderloin,
sentences.zh: 专门针对居住在旧金山田德隆区的跨性别群体，

sentences.en: which was sort of the down-and-out skid row section of town that tended to collect people
sentences.zh: 那儿算是城里贫困潦倒的贫民窟，往往聚集着那些

sentences.en: who couldn't afford to live anywhere else or who had run out of options.
sentences.zh: 负担不起其他地方的居住费用或走投无路的人。

sentences.en: Trans people who ended up in the Tenderloin were at high risk for drug addiction and prostitution.
sentences.zh: 最终流落到田德隆区的跨性别者面临着极高的毒瘾和卖淫风险。

sentences.en: When Sandy got in touch with the police to ask for help,
sentences.zh: 当桑迪联系警察寻求帮助时，

sentences.en: the first thing they did was to dissuade her from acting on her feelings.
sentences.zh: 他们做的第一件事就是劝阻她不要顺从自己的感受。

sentences.en: And they actually tried to discourage me by taking on a tour
sentences.zh: 他们实际上试图通过带我参观来劝退我，

sentences.en: that reminded me of Dante being led down into the lower circles of hell.
sentences.zh: 那让我想起但丁被带入地狱底层的情景。

sentences.en: They really showed me the worst of everything and then said,
sentences.zh: 他们真的向我展示了最糟糕的一切，然后说，

sentences.en: are you sure you still want to go ahead with what you're thinking of?
sentences.zh: 你确定还要继续你所想的那样做吗？

sentences.en: And to be perfectly honest, I was not quite sure what I was thinking of.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我当时并不完全确定自己在想什么。

sentences.en: I was just trying to collect information.
And I think it would be safe to say that that's what we were all doing at that time.
sentences.zh: 我想可以肯定地说，那也是我们当时所有人都在做的事情。

sentences.en: Still, the referral to the police turned out to be a stroke of luck.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，警察的推荐最终成了一次幸运的转机。

sentences.en: The cops told her that a center at Stanford University
sentences.zh: 警察告诉她，斯坦福大学的一个中心

sentences.en: had recently started performing what were then called sex change operations.
sentences.zh: 最近开始进行当时所谓的变性手术。

sentences.en: They didn't refer me to Stanford as much as talk about it,
sentences.zh: 他们与其说是推荐我去斯坦福，不如说是谈论它，

sentences.en: as the great unattainable goal, the great beautiful shining star in the sky.
sentences.zh: 把它描述为伟大的、不可企及的目标，天空中那颗美丽闪耀的明星。

sentences.en: After years of suffering and loneliness and confusion,
sentences.zh: 经历了多年的痛苦、孤独和困惑后，

sentences.en: the Stanford program felt like a beacon.
sentences.zh: 斯坦福的项目感觉就像一座灯塔。

sentences.en: Sandy felt she might finally have a chance to live a more honest, satisfying life.
sentences.zh: 桑迪觉得她终于有机会过上一种更诚实、更满足的生活了。

sentences.en: But first, she had to convince the gatekeeper who stood between her and the person she wanted to become.
sentences.zh: 但首先，她必须说服那个站在她和她想成为的人之间的守门人。

sentences.en: He ran what was then called the gender dysphoria program at Stanford.
sentences.zh: 他负责当时斯坦福大学所谓的性别焦虑项目。

sentences.en: The gatekeeper of Stanford's gender dysphoria program was a hedgehog.
sentences.zh: 斯坦福性别焦虑项目的守门人是一只“刺猬”。

sentences.en: From a very early age, he had a big picture idea.
sentences.zh: 从很小的时候起，他就有一个宏大的构想。

sentences.en: He wanted to help a lot of people.
As a small child, when kids in his school were asked to donate money to a charity,
sentences.zh: 小时候，当学校里的孩子被要求为慈善机构捐款时，
他的同学们捐了一角钱。

sentences.en: Don worked in a vegetable garden an entire summer to raise a whopping $10.
sentences.zh: 唐整个夏天都在菜园里干活，筹集了整整10美元。

sentences.en: Now, I got a letter, a preserved letter that my mother wrote to some of her friends
sentences.zh: 我收到了一封信，一封我母亲写给朋友的保存完好的信，

sentences.en: saying, Don, he's done something that nobody has ever done.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，唐，他做了一件没人做过的事。

sentences.en: Don's father feared his little boy was consumed with being a do-gooder,
sentences.zh: 唐的父亲担心他的小儿子一心只想做一个善人，

sentences.en: that he would turn out to be a failure at business.

sentences.zh: 唐·洛布成为了一名医生。

sentences.en: When he came to Stanford in the 1960s, he was a young, ambitious plastic surgeon,
sentences.zh: 当他在20世纪60年代来到斯坦福时，他是一位年轻、雄心勃勃的整形外科医生，

sentences.en: very much in awe of his prize-winning colleagues.
sentences.zh: 对他的获奖同事们非常敬畏。

sentences.en: Coming to Stanford, I was overshadowed by the hugeness of what people were doing,
sentences.zh: 来到斯坦福，我被人们所做之事的宏大和重要性所震撼，

sentences.en: So I knew that I had to do something, like maybe, you know, I've got to do this somewhere
sentences.zh: 所以我知道我必须做点什么，比如，你知道，我必须在某个时候做这件事，

sentences.en: along the line, because everybody else here is doing it.
sentences.zh: 因为这里的每个人都在做。

sentences.en: Don was looking for a place to make his mark.
sentences.zh: 唐一直在寻找一个能让他留下印记的地方。

sentences.en: One day, a colleague walked out of an examination room and came up to him.
sentences.zh: 有一天，一位同事从检查室走出来，走到他面前。

sentences.en: I said, Don, I want you to see a patient.
sentences.zh: 我说，唐，我想让你看一个病人。

sentences.en: I said, Dave, send that patient away.
sentences.zh: 我说，戴夫，把那个病人打发走。

sentences.en: I'm a Catholic boy from the Midwest, and I'm at Stanford.
sentences.zh: 我是个来自中西部的天主教男孩，而且我是在斯坦福。

sentences.en: But Don's colleague insisted he meet the patient.
sentences.zh: 但唐的同事坚持要他见见病人。

sentences.en: To be clear, this patient was not Sandy Stone.
sentences.zh: 需要说明的是，这个病人不是桑迪·斯通。

sentences.en: And he said, Do me a favor and go in that room.
sentences.zh: 他说，帮我个忙，进那个房间去看看。

sentences.en: So I went in the room and talked to the patient.
sentences.zh: 于是我进了房间，和病人谈了谈。

sentences.en: And I said, Now, why do you want a sex change?
sentences.zh: 我说，现在，你为什么要变性？

sentences.en: She said, Well, I was born, and this is what I should be.
sentences.zh: 她说，嗯，我出生时就是这样，这才是原本的我。

sentences.en: I said, Well, when did you decide that?
sentences.zh: 我说，那你是什么时候决定的？

sentences.en: She said, I didn't decide it.
This is what I was born with from day one.
sentences.zh: 这是我从出生第一天起就有的特质。

sentences.en: No one on the West Coast had received what's come to be known today as gender reassignment surgery or gender confirmation surgery.
sentences.zh: 当时西海岸还没有人接受过今天所谓的性别重置手术或性别确认手术。

sentences.en: In fact, the surgery had been rarely performed across the whole world.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这种手术在全世界范围内都很少进行。

sentences.en: Don was an unlikely choice of doctor.
sentences.zh: 唐是一个不太可能的人选。

sentences.en: He was, by his own account, a prim man from the MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 用他自己的话说，他是一个来自中西部的古板男人。

sentences.en: But although Don initially blanched at the idea of gender reassignment surgery, he felt a shiver of excitement.
sentences.zh: 但尽管唐最初对性别重置手术的想法感到退缩，他还是感到了一阵兴奋。

sentences.en: He didn't send the patient away.
Instead, he went looking for information.
sentences.zh: 相反，他开始寻找相关信息。

sentences.en: He consulted with psychiatrists and the few surgeons around the world who'd already performed this kind of surgery.
sentences.zh: 他咨询了精神科医生和世界上少数已经做过这种手术的外科医生。

sentences.en: What prompted you, this sort of Catholic doctor from the Midwest, to basically take this on?
sentences.zh: 是什么促使你，这个来自中西部的天主教医生，基本上承担起了这件事？

sentences.en: It seems like an unlikely fit.
It was a wonderful opportunity to do a big thing and to help a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 这是一个做大事并帮助许多人的绝佳机会。

sentences.en: Altruism and ambition were always tightly woven in Don's identity.
sentences.zh: 利他主义和野心总是紧密地交织在唐的身份中。

sentences.en: He wasn't interested in superficial cosmetic work.
sentences.zh: 他对肤浅的美容手术不感兴趣。

sentences.en: He wanted to change the world.
He decided to take the leap.
In November 1968, Don Law performed California's first gender reassignment surgery.
sentences.zh: 1968年11月，唐·劳布（Don Laub）完成了加州首例性别重置手术。

sentences.en: That we were more than prepared for all the things that might happen.
sentences.zh: 我们对可能发生的一切都做好了充分的准备。

sentences.en: It took about three and a half hours.
And we did it with the skin graft method.
sentences.zh: 我们采用了植皮手术的方法。

sentences.en: Don soon became one of the world's leading experts on gender reassignment surgery.
sentences.zh: 唐很快成为了全球性别重置手术领域的顶尖专家之一。

sentences.en: A reputation for being a good surgeon and a tough gatekeeper.
sentences.zh: 他以优秀的医生和严格的把关人而闻名。

sentences.en: He turned away many people because he felt they weren't good candidates for surgery.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝了许多人，因为他觉得他们并不适合接受手术。

sentences.en: Sandy Stone vividly remembers her first appointment with him in the mid-70s.
sentences.zh: 桑迪·斯通（Sandy Stone）清晰地记得70年代中期她第一次去见他的情景。

sentences.en: I go in and sit down and Don is behind his desk and he's wearing his white coat.
sentences.zh: 我走进去坐下，唐坐在办公桌后面，穿着白大褂。

sentences.en: And he's very distinguished looking and calm and very friendly and open.
sentences.zh: 他看起来非常儒雅、冷静，而且非常友好、开明。

sentences.en: And he says, well, what can I do for you?
sentences.zh: 他问我，有什么我可以帮你的吗？

sentences.en: And I say, the first thing that comes into my head, which is, I think I'm a woman.
sentences.zh: 我脱口而出，脑子里想到的第一句话就是：我觉得我是个女人。

sentences.en: Now, the scene we have is Don behind his desk and me.
sentences.zh: 当时的情景就是唐坐在桌后，而我坐在对面。

sentences.en: I have a long black beard and wild black hair.
sentences.zh: 我留着长长的黑胡子，头发乱蓬蓬的。

sentences.en: I'm wearing a blue shirt, jeans, and engineer's boots.
sentences.zh: 我穿着蓝色衬衫、牛仔裤，脚蹬工装靴。

sentences.en: I do not exactly look like I'm thinking of myself as a stereotypical woman.
sentences.zh: 我看起来并不像是那种会把自己视为传统女性的人。

sentences.en: And Don looks at me and says, really?
And I say, what should I do?
I mean, I'm totally, I'm completely open to anything.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我完全、彻底地接受任何建议。

sentences.en: I really don't know what I should do, what direction I should move in, what's right, what's wrong.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道该怎么做，该往哪个方向走，什么是对的，什么是错的。

sentences.en: And I'm looking to Donald to tell me.
sentences.zh: 我在指望唐纳德给我指点。

sentences.en: And in my memory of the thing, Donald then says, well, the first thing you should do is lose the beard.
sentences.zh: 在我的记忆里，唐纳德当时说：好吧，你首先要做的是把胡子刮了。

sentences.en: That was the beginning of Sandy's long transformative journey.
sentences.zh: 那是桑迪漫长蜕变之旅的开始。

sentences.en: Don wanted Sandy to be sure she was making the right decision.
sentences.zh: 唐希望桑迪能确定自己做出了正确的决定。

sentences.en: So before he would even consider surgery, Sandy says he told her she would have to live openly and fully as a woman for one full year.
sentences.zh: 所以，在考虑手术之前，桑迪说他要求她必须以女性身份公开、完整地生活整整一年。

sentences.en: It was a requirement based on the reality of the time.
sentences.zh: 这是一个基于当时现实情况的要求。

sentences.en: No one, not Sandy, nor Don, knew what might come from these surgeries in the long term.
sentences.zh: 没有人，无论是桑迪还是唐，知道这些手术从长远来看会带来什么结果。

sentences.en: It was all a bit of an experiment, a shot in the dark.
sentences.zh: 这一切都有点像实验，是在黑暗中摸索。
对每个人来说都充满了艰辛。

sentences.en: And it was fraught because at that time it was not clear what would happen later.
sentences.zh: 之所以艰辛，是因为在当时，没人清楚未来会发生什么。

sentences.en: We didn't have very many examples of transgender people who had had surgery who went on to have fulfilling lives and lived to tell about it, which is to say,
sentences.zh: 我们没有太多跨性别者在接受手术后过上充实生活并能现身说法的例子，也就是说，

sentences.en: came back later and reported back to the program.
sentences.zh: 后来回到项目组进行反馈的例子很少。

sentences.en: They were experimenting on the fringe of what both medicine and society thought was acceptable.
sentences.zh: 他们是在医学界和当时社会所能接受的边缘进行实验。

sentences.en: Don was taking risks with his professional reputation.
sentences.zh: 唐是在拿自己的职业声誉冒险。

sentences.en: Sandy was taking risks with her life.
sentences.zh: 桑迪是在拿自己的生命冒险。

sentences.en: There was one moment, Sandy says, when she and Don clashed.
sentences.zh: 桑迪说，有一次她和唐发生了冲突。

sentences.en: The conflict boiled down to their cognitive styles.
sentences.zh: 冲突归根结底是由于他们的认知方式不同。

sentences.en: At some point he asked me if I were 100% committed to wanting surgery.
sentences.zh: 有一次他问我是否百分之百确定想要做手术。

sentences.en: And I said, no, I'm not.
I think anyone who's 100% committed to anything is probably crazy.
sentences.zh: 我觉得任何对某事百分之百确定的人可能都疯了。

sentences.en: You have to have some reservations in life.
sentences.zh: 生活中你必须保留一些余地。

sentences.en: You have to have an overview of everything that you're doing and have alternative plans if what you're looking for doesn't work out.
sentences.zh: 你必须对自己所做的一切有一个全局观，如果追求的目标没有实现，还要有替代方案。

sentences.en: And Don said, well, in that case, you're not eligible for surgery.
sentences.zh: 唐说，既然这样，那你就不符合手术条件。

sentences.en: It took a mediated session with Don's assistant for the two of them to resolve the conflict.
sentences.zh: 最后在唐的助手的调解下，两人才解决了这个冲突。

sentences.en: But the incident revealed something about the way a hedgehog moves through the world.
sentences.zh: 但这件事揭示了“刺猬”在世界上行事的一些特点。

sentences.en: Don could not understand anything less than 100% commitment, even if the 0.1% of doubt was simply a way to say,
sentences.zh: 唐无法理解任何低于百分之百的承诺，即使那0.1%的怀疑仅仅是一种表达方式，意思是：

sentences.en: How can I be absolutely sure?
Sandy tells another story of a time she came in for an appointment wearing jeans and a t-shirt.
sentences.zh: 桑迪讲了另一件事，有一次她穿着牛仔裤和T恤去赴约。

sentences.en: Don asked her why she wasn't dressed like a woman.
sentences.zh: 唐问她为什么没有穿得像个女人。

sentences.en: He'd missed the bell-bottom jeans and tie-dye revolution happening right outside his window.
sentences.zh: 他错过了窗外正在发生的喇叭裤和扎染革命。

sentences.en: It was the kind of thing that could have led to a fight, except for one thing.
sentences.zh: 这本可能导致一场争吵，但有一点除外。

sentences.en: Sandy understood where Don was coming from.
She knew that underneath the tough exterior, he really wanted to help.
sentences.zh: 她知道在坚硬的外表下，他是真心想帮忙。

sentences.en: And not just in a medical sense.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是在医学意义上。

sentences.en: More than anything, Don wanted Sandy to live a life where she didn't feel like an outcaSt.
sentences.zh: 唐最希望的是桑迪能过上一种不觉得自己是局外人的生活。

sentences.en: He wanted his people to be totally unremarkable.
sentences.zh: 他希望他帮助的人能完全不引人注目。

sentences.en: To be able to live their lives.
To be able to be inconspicuous and just get along.
sentences.zh: 能不显眼，只是平平淡淡地过日子。

sentences.en: And that's a good thing to want for 99% of your waking day.
sentences.zh: 对于你清醒时99%的时间来说，这是一种很好的追求。

sentences.en: It's just to be able to live your life.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是能够过上自己的生活。

sentences.en: To be able to live with other people and not rub people the wrong way.
sentences.zh: 能够与他人共处，而不与人发生摩擦。

sentences.en: Sandy Stone successfully underwent surgery in 1977.
sentences.zh: 桑迪·斯通于1977年成功接受了手术。

sentences.en: When I interviewed Sandy, I told her that her story reminded me of another case that Don told me about.
sentences.zh: 当我采访桑迪时，我告诉她，她的故事让我想起了唐曾告诉我的另一个案例。

sentences.en: It's interesting because Don first came to my attention because of another case involving cleft lip surgery.
sentences.zh: 很有意思，因为我最初注意到唐是因为另一个涉及唇裂手术的案例。

sentences.en: And it's so striking that as you're saying this, I'm sort of hearing echoes of that other work as well.
sentences.zh: 当你这么说的时候，我仿佛听到了那项工作的回响，这太令人震撼了。

sentences.en: This drive that he had to just help people to essentially live what he would think of as being a normal life.
sentences.zh: 他那种想要帮助人们过上他所认为的正常生活的动力。

sentences.en: A life that they're not ostracized, a life that they're not feeling like they're outcasts, that they're functioning, they can get an education if they're a child,
sentences.zh: 一种不被排斥、不觉得自己是局外人、能够正常运作、如果是孩子就能接受教育的生活，

sentences.en: that they can get a job if they're an adult, that they can be happy.
sentences.zh: 如果是成年人就能找到工作，能够感到幸福的生活。

sentences.en: And I feel there's something actually very Midwestern about that idea.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这个想法其实非常有美国中西部特色。

sentences.en: That word you said is correct.
Don wanted people to be happy.

sentences.zh: 唐是以专业的方式做到的。

sentences.en: His job was to help people to be happy.
sentences.zh: 他的工作就是帮助人们获得幸福。

sentences.en: And for that, I owe him a lifetime debt.
sentences.zh: 对此，我欠他一辈子的债。

sentences.en: I would not have done anything, I think, that I did after the 1980s if it weren't for Don Laub, or the 70s, rather, if it weren't for Don Laub.
sentences.zh: 如果不是唐·劳布，我想我不会做任何我在80年代之后，或者说是70年代之后所做的事情。

sentences.en: Sandy went on to become a prominent writer and theorist and eventually helped found the academic discipline of transgender studies.
sentences.zh: 桑迪后来成为了一名杰出的作家和理论家，并最终帮助创立了跨性别研究这一学术学科。

sentences.en: When she considers Don's influence on her life, she homes in on his willingness to pursue a big idea with single-minded purpose.
sentences.zh: 当她思考唐对她生活的影响时，她关注的是他那种一心一意追求宏大目标的意愿。

sentences.en: Do you go for the big one, or do you accept something less?
sentences.zh: 你是去追求那个宏大的目标，还是接受一些次优的选择？

sentences.en: And many of us accept something less because we don't want to take the risk.
sentences.zh: 我们许多人选择了次优，因为我们不想冒险。

sentences.en: And then we may go through life, maybe, maybe we'll be happy with our measure.
sentences.zh: 然后我们可能会过完一生，也许，也许我们会对自己所得到的感到满足。

sentences.en: Or maybe we'll say, what if I had gone for what I really wanted?
sentences.zh: 或者也许我们会说，如果我当初追求了我真正想要的呢？

sentences.en: What would that have been like?
Don's leap into the unknown, his willingness to bet his professional reputation on a big idea, his confidence in his own judgment,
sentences.zh: 唐向未知的跃进，他愿意拿自己的职业声誉去赌一个宏大的想法，他对自己的判断充满信心，

sentences.en: But pursuing a big idea with determination doesn't always pay off.
sentences.zh: 但坚定地追求一个宏大的想法并不总是有回报的。

sentences.en: And when a hedgehog fails, the fall can be painful.
sentences.zh: 当刺猬失败时，跌落可能会很痛苦。

sentences.en: Don Laub knows about that part of the story, too.
sentences.zh: 唐·劳布也了解故事的那一部分。

sentences.en: According to the ancient Greek poet Archilochus, the fox knows many things, but the hedgehog knows one big thing.
sentences.zh: 古希腊诗人阿尔基洛库斯曾说，狐狸知道许多事情，而刺猬只知道一件大事。

sentences.en: Psychologist Phil Tetlock says the metaphor describes two kinds of people.
sentences.zh: 心理学家菲尔·泰特洛克说，这个隐喻描述了两种人。
关注细节的战术家是狐狸。
关注全局的战略家是刺猬。

sentences.en: Before Don Laub became a world-renowned gender reassignment surgeon, he had another big idea.
sentences.zh: 在唐·劳布成为世界知名的性别重置外科医生之前，他还有过另一个宏大的想法。

sentences.en: One day, a colleague asked him if he could help with the surgery.
sentences.zh: 有一天，一位同事问他是否可以帮忙做手术。

sentences.en: The patient was a child from Mexico.
sentences.zh: 病人是一个来自墨西哥的孩子。

sentences.en: This was a 14-year-old boy who had no other deformity than his cleft lip and palate.
sentences.zh: 这是一个14岁的男孩，除了唇腭裂之外没有其他畸形。

sentences.en: But because of it, the boy was shunned.
sentences.zh: 但正因为如此，这个男孩遭到了排斥。

sentences.en: A group of priests had driven him north, all the way to Stanford, to get him help.
sentences.zh: 一群牧师把他一路带到了北方的斯坦福大学，寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Don immediately understood that the cleft lip wasn't just a medical problem.
sentences.zh: 唐立刻明白，唇裂不仅仅是一个医学问题。

sentences.en: He had not gone to school.

sentences.zh: 他没有任何受教育的机会。

sentences.en: The surgery to repair the cleft lip and palate was simple and quick.
sentences.zh: 修复唇腭裂的手术简单而迅速。

sentences.en: It was so easy, and it gave this child a real chance in life.
sentences.zh: 这太容易了，却给了这个孩子真正的人生机会。

sentences.en: Don says performing the surgery made him feel really good.
sentences.zh: 唐说，做完手术让他感觉非常好。

sentences.en: As someone with deep religious roots and a Catholic education that emphasized helping the poor,
sentences.zh: 作为一个有着深厚宗教根基并接受过强调帮助穷人的天主教教育的人，

sentences.en: Don felt this was the kind of patient he wanted to serve.
sentences.zh: 唐觉得这就是他想要服务的病人类型。

sentences.en: He turned to the priest who'd brought the boy from Mexico.
sentences.zh: 他转向了那位把男孩从墨西哥带来的牧师。

sentences.en: I asked him, are there other patients in Mexico like this?
sentences.zh: 我问他，墨西哥还有其他这样的病人吗？

sentences.en: They said, well, the place is full of them.
So we bought an airplane ticket and went down to Mexicali and asked for a clinic.
sentences.zh: 于是我们买了张机票，去了墨西卡利，要求建立一个诊所。

sentences.en: Where a fox may have calculated the odds, considered the upside and the downside,
sentences.zh: 狐狸可能会计算胜算，权衡利弊，

sentences.en: the hedgehog simply picked up and went.
sentences.zh: 而刺猬只是收拾行囊就出发了。

sentences.en: In Mexicali, Don found a dusty border town in the desert where the people were very poor.
sentences.zh: 在墨西卡利，唐发现了一个沙漠中尘土飞扬的边境小镇，那里的人们非常贫穷。

sentences.en: I mean, most of the houses were made of packing crates at that time,
sentences.zh: 我是说，当时大多数房子都是用包装箱做的，

sentences.en: and there was no paving in Mexicali of 200,000 people.
sentences.zh: 而且那个拥有20万人口的墨西卡利连一条铺好的路都没有。

sentences.en: Mexicali's main medical facility was an old wood home.
sentences.zh: 墨西卡利的主要医疗设施是一座破旧的木屋。

sentences.en: It had a dirt floor for part of it.
The back part of the clinic was used to raise fighting cocks.
sentences.zh: 诊所的后部被用来养斗鸡。

sentences.en: A rational fox may have calculated the risks and backed down.
sentences.zh: 理性的狐狸可能会计算风险并退缩。

sentences.en: He recruited local health officials to get word out that they would be providing free surgeries for children
sentences.zh: 他招募了当地的卫生官员，宣传他们将为患有唇裂和烧伤疤痕的儿童提供免费手术。

sentences.en: with cleft lips and burn scars.

sentences.zh: 在那片沙漠里，已经三年没下过雨了。

sentences.en: In that desert, there had not been rain there for three years.
sentences.zh: 早晨就很热，气温已经达到了约106华氏度（约41摄氏度）。

sentences.en: Hot in the morning, it was about 106 degrees already.
sentences.zh: 你不能碰任何金属，否则会烫伤手。

sentences.en: You couldn't touch anything metal because you'd burn your hand.
sentences.zh: 我看到的第一个病人坐在那里，头上套着一个袋子，上面开了两个小孔。

sentences.en: The first patient I saw was sitting there with a bag on his head with two little peepholes.
sentences.zh: 我问，为什么要套个袋子？
我问，为什么要套个袋子？

sentences.en: Behind those peepholes, the boy was hiding his face in shame.
sentences.zh: 在那些窥视孔后面，那个男孩正羞愧地遮住自己的脸。

sentences.en: Don asked if he could take a look.
So he got the bag off, and he had a burn scar to pull this eyelid down.
sentences.zh: 于是他摘下了袋子，发现他眼睑上有一道烧伤疤痕，把眼皮往下拉。

sentences.en: As with Sandy, Don wanted to make the little boy unremarkable.
sentences.zh: 和对待桑迪一样，唐想让这个小男孩变得不再引人注目。

sentences.en: He wanted him to lead an ordinary life, unmarked by stigma and shame.
sentences.zh: 他希望他能过上普通人的生活，不再受污名和羞耻的困扰。

sentences.en: That first trip was just a fact-finding mission, a way to see if there was a need.
sentences.zh: 第一次行程只是为了摸底，看看是否有这种需求。

sentences.en: By the time Don went back to Stanford, a plan had formed in his mind.
sentences.zh: 当唐回到斯坦福大学时，心中已经形成了一个计划。

sentences.en: He wanted to recruit the best doctors from the United States and fly them to Mexico
sentences.zh: 他想从美国招募最优秀的医生，并带他们飞往墨西哥，

sentences.en: to perform free surgeries on children with birth defects.
sentences.zh: 为患有先天缺陷的儿童进行免费手术。

sentences.en: He recruited surgical residents to join skilled surgeons on the trips.
sentences.zh: 他招募了外科住院医师，让他们加入熟练的外科医生团队一起前往。

sentences.en: He found pilots willing to transport medical equipment.
sentences.zh: 他找到了愿意运送医疗设备的飞行员。

sentences.en: They can see the shining city on the hill so clearly that everyone around them starts to see it too.
sentences.zh: 他们能如此清晰地看到山巅上那座闪耀的城市，以至于周围的人也开始看到了。

sentences.en: I had to hide when I go in the hospital because people wanted to get in on this.
sentences.zh: 我进医院时不得不躲起来，因为人们都想参与进来。

sentences.en: In 1966, the official medical missions began.
Now, it's important to remember that at this time, the idea of plastic surgeons going abroad to provide free surgery was almost unheard of.
sentences.zh: 现在，必须记住，在当时，整形外科医生出国提供免费手术的想法几乎闻所未闻。

sentences.en: There were fewer parameters of how international aid organizations should operate.
sentences.zh: 当时对于国际援助组织应该如何运作，并没有太多的准则。

sentences.en: Don was flying by the seat of his pants.
sentences.zh: 唐当时完全是在摸着石头过河。

sentences.en: Every few months, the doctors would descend on Mexicali.
sentences.zh: 每隔几个月，医生们就会来到墨西卡利。

sentences.en: They'd throw themselves into four marathon days of back-to-back surgeries and consultations.
sentences.zh: 他们会全身心投入到为期四天的马拉松式手术和会诊中。

sentences.en: Over the years, they'd come back, again and again, performing more than 2,000 surgeries in all.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他们一次又一次地回来，总共进行了2000多台手术。

sentences.en: One of Don's first patients was a little boy named Eugenio.
sentences.zh: 唐最早的病人之一是一个叫尤金尼奥的小男孩。

sentences.en: He was the boy who'd worn the bag over his head.
sentences.zh: 他就是那个头上套着袋子的男孩。

sentences.en: Don repaired the scarred eyelid and still remembers the boy's first reaction.
sentences.zh: 唐修复了他那道有疤痕的眼睑，至今仍记得那个男孩的第一次反应。

sentences.en: He had a very nice, huge smile.
sentences.zh: 他露出了一个非常灿烂、巨大的笑容。

sentences.en: On a follow-up trip, Don tracked Eugenio down.
sentences.zh: 在一次后续回访中，唐找到了尤金尼奥。

sentences.en: He shook hands and everything like that, even as a young kid.
sentences.zh: 他握了手，做了所有这些动作，尽管他还是个小孩子。

sentences.en: And he said, I have friends at school now.
sentences.zh: 他说，我现在在学校有朋友了。
如果非要说的话，唐有一种……

sentences.en: I would describe it as a very...
sentences.zh: 我会把它描述为一种非常……

sentences.en: And I think he would accept this.
sentences.zh: 我想他会接受这个说法。

sentences.en: I think it was a very sort of missionary zeal.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一种传教士般的热忱。

sentences.en: This is plastic surgeon Howard Holderness.
sentences.zh: 这位是整形外科医生霍华德·霍尔德内斯。

sentences.en: He was part of the team of residents helping perform surgeries in Mexicali.
sentences.zh: 他是协助在墨西卡利进行手术的住院医师团队的一员。

sentences.en: Howard says that Don's vision drove the whole team.
sentences.zh: 霍华德说，唐的愿景驱动了整个团队。

sentences.en: I think he felt very close to trying to do things that not only practice medicine
sentences.zh: 我觉得他非常渴望做一些事情，不仅是实践医学，

sentences.en: in all of its forms of science and everything,
sentences.zh: 包括科学及其所有形式的一切，

sentences.en: but the art of medicine and some of the spiritual aspects of being a good doctor.
sentences.zh: 还有医学的艺术，以及作为一名好医生所具备的一些精神层面。

sentences.en: He was doing more than surgeries.
sentences.zh: 他所做的不仅仅是手术。

sentences.en: Don was developing a program that could set an example for others to follow around the world.
sentences.zh: 唐正在开发一个可以为世界各地树立榜样的项目。

sentences.en: One day, about two years into the Mexico program,
sentences.zh: 有一天，在墨西哥项目开展大约两年后，

sentences.en: a woman arrived at the clinic with her young son.
sentences.zh: 一位妇女带着她的小儿子来到了诊所。

sentences.en: Compared with the other patients, Salvador had a more severe birth defect.
sentences.zh: 与其他病人相比，萨尔瓦多的先天缺陷更为严重。

sentences.en: He had bilateral clefts, two clefts rather than one.
sentences.zh: 他患有双侧裂，有两个裂口而不是一个。

sentences.en: When you have the bilateral, the muscles are cut twice.
sentences.zh: 当你患有双侧裂时，肌肉会被切开两次。

sentences.en: So when you smile, they pull out.
sentences.zh: 所以当你微笑时，它们会向外拉。

sentences.en: If they're repaired, they pull in.
sentences.zh: 如果修复了，它们就会向内拉。

sentences.en: So every time he would have a facial expression, it would be awful.
sentences.zh: 所以每次他做面部表情时，都会显得很可怕。

sentences.en: You'd see these teeth on both sides.
Salvador was a perfect candidate for surgery.
sentences.zh: 萨尔瓦多是手术的完美人选。

sentences.en: That is, until a doctor on the team gave the boy a thorough physical
sentences.zh: 然而，团队里的一位医生给男孩做了彻底的体检，

sentences.en: and listened to his heart with a stethoscope.
sentences.zh: 并用听诊器听了他的心脏。

sentences.en: His mother brought him in and the pediatrician listened.
sentences.zh: 他母亲带他进来，儿科医生听了听。

sentences.en: And he goes, whoosh, whoosh, whoosh.
The boy's heart had a hole in it.
sentences.zh: 这个男孩的心脏有个洞。

sentences.en: The risk of proceeding with surgery was small, but potentially fatal.
sentences.zh: 进行手术的风险很小，但有致命的可能。

sentences.en: They gave the mother the bad news.
sentences.zh: 他们把这个坏消息告诉了母亲。

sentences.en: We can't operate because we don't have the equipment in Mexicali
sentences.zh: 我们不能手术，因为我们在墨西卡利没有设备

sentences.en: to do the heart catheterization or anything like that
sentences.zh: 来做心脏导管检查之类的手术，

sentences.en: or even get to the EKG today.
sentences.zh: 甚至今天连心电图都做不了。

sentences.en: So Don and his team turned away the mother and the little boy.
sentences.zh: 于是唐和他的团队拒绝了这位母亲和小男孩。

sentences.en: I should say here that we're going only on Don's account of what happened.
sentences.zh: 我应该说明一下，我们这里讲述的完全是基于唐的叙述。

sentences.en: The medical records from that era are incomplete,
sentences.zh: 那个时代的医疗记录不完整，

sentences.en: and we weren't able to find the mother.
sentences.zh: 我们也没能找到那位母亲。

sentences.en: A few months after sending the child away,
Don and his team were back in Mexicali.
sentences.zh: 唐和他的团队又回到了墨西卡利。

sentences.en: The mother and her son were waiting for them again.
sentences.zh: 那位母亲和她的儿子又在等他们了。

sentences.en: Salvador, she told them, was shunned.
sentences.zh: 她说，萨尔瓦多遭到了排斥。

sentences.en: Other children called him El Monstre, the monster.
The mother said, this child has no chance in life.
sentences.zh: 母亲说，这孩子这辈子没希望了。

sentences.en: The risk was small, but it did mean that things could go seriously wrong.
sentences.zh: 风险很小，但确实意味着事情可能会严重恶化。

sentences.zh: 唐把听诊器举到母亲的耳朵上。

sentences.en: So the answer again was no.
Can you see this child has no life?
sentences.zh: 你看不到这孩子没法活了吗？

Medical protocol said that was the right call.
sentences.zh: 医疗规程说那是正确的决定。

sentences.en: Could he have tried to take the boy back to Stanford,

and a drain on critical resources from the project in Mexico,

sentences.en: So Don did what Don always did.
sentences.zh: 所以唐做了他一贯的做法。

sentences.en: He took a look at the child,
I feel like that's why I existed,
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就是我存在的意义，

sentences.en: I mean, I'm not there to take care of little pimples.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不是来处理小粉刺的。

sentences.en: I'm there to do the tough cases.
sentences.zh: 我是来处理棘手病例的。

sentences.en: So this was putting it right on the line.
You got to do it or put your tail between your legs and get out of there.
sentences.zh: 你必须去做，否则就夹着尾巴逃走。

sentences.en: It's been nearly 50 years since Don Law performed that surgery
sentences.zh: 距离唐·劳在墨西哥墨西卡利为一名六岁男孩进行那次手术，已经过去近50年了。

sentences.en: on a six-year-old boy in Mexicali, Mexico.
sentences.zh: 从那以后他有了成千上万的病人，

sentences.en: He's had thousands of patients since then,
sentences.zh: 但那一天的细节在他脑海中依然清晰可见。

sentences.en: but the details of that day are still vivid in his mind.

And he gets on the operating table himself
because he trusts the whole world.

They put away their surgical tools.

Don's heart was starting to race.

and he had made a risky judgment call
sentences.zh: 却做出了一个冒险的决定，

Why am I here in Mexico?

这简直是一场该死的灾难。
